name: Gomer
bio: Gomer, daughter of Diblaim, was the unfaithful wife the LORD commanded Hosea to marry as a living symbol of Israel's unfaithfulness to God. She bore him children given symbolic names of judgment, then left him for other lovers; Hosea later bought her back for fifteen shekels of silver and some barley and required her to live faithfully with him, reenacting God's persistent love for an unfaithful people (Hosea 1:2-3:5).
